verdict.rationale: Missive ships an in-product AI assistant (Copilot) that can compose, reply and translate messages, run long sessions tied to conversations, and reach internal data through custom MCP connections, so the AI does work on the user's data inside the app. Explicit insight generation (summaries, trends, analytic suggestions) is only shown for external apps like Claude via MCP, which happens outside Missive and isn't credited here. The assistant also runs on the customer's own Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini key. Missing for 10: documented in-product summaries or insights over inbox/team data, proactive suggestions surfaced from data, AI-driven analytics insights, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Quickly compose, reply, and translate messages with AI directly in Missive.
connect any MCP-compatible server to Missive's AI Copilot and let AI interact with your internal systems, proprietary data, or homegrown tools.
The session tab now shows what the assistant is up to, and a conversation links back to the sessions attached to it.
The assistant runs on your own API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google Gemini.
